posts.title: Where does rain come from?
posts.folder: Rodney Shop → Social → Seed Posts - Instagram & Facebook
posts.instagram:
"Where does rain come from?" 🌧️
Rodney's answer, in 4 easy steps:
1. The sun warms the water
2. It rises as vapour
3. Clouds form
4. Rain falls back down... and the journey starts again!
Save this for the next rainy-day question ⭐

youtube.title: Meet Rodney the Raindrop! 💧 Games, Songs, Stories & Adventures for Kids
youtube.description:
Meet Rodney the Raindrop! 💧 Drip, drip, DROP!

Rodney is a little raindrop on a big adventure around the world. He rides the water cycle up into the clouds and rains down somewhere new, visiting famous places and meeting animals as he goes.

Come and join him:
🎮 Play Rodney's games: collect raindrops, win stickers and fill your sticker book
📺 Watch Rodney TV: songs, stories and adventures
📚 Read the storybooks and colouring books
🖍️ Print the activity packs and fill your World Passport
🌙 Get ready for bed with Rodney at sleepy time

Gentle, ad-free learning for ages 2–6. Play and watch more at rodneytheraindrop.com 💧

#RodneyTheRaindrop #WaterCycleForKids #KidsLearning
